Samir / CobaltTrust Security Team — please find our compiled responses below and attachments referenced in the Controls Matrix. This message contains the authoritative answers for this pass.

--- Answers (summary) ---
1) Control ownership and escalation paths:
- Critical services (tokenization, inference runtime, telemetry ingestion) are owned by the Serving Runtime team (Marissa Cole, Senior PM). Incident escalation: Eng on-call -> Head of Infra -> CISO.

2) RTO / RPO targets and measured SLAs:
- Short interactive requests (99th p50-p99 measured): target 50ms median, 400ms 99th for standard hosted API across NA regions.
- RTO for full service failover (cross-region): target 15 minutes for control-plane failover; 60 minutes for stateless inference workload warming with cache rebuild. Documented in the DR runbook (attached excerpt).

3) Backup & retention for critical configs and keys:
- Configs: daily encrypted snapshots to customer-dedicated S3 buckets (or equivalent) retained 90 days by default; snapshot hashes stored in immutable ledger.
- Keys: KMS/HSM integrations; customer-managed keys supported for Private deployments. Key rotation documented and logs retained 365 days.

4) Operational evidence provided:
- Attached: Operational_Controls_Matrix.pdf (annotated matrix matching your workbook), Redwood_Inference_Resilience_Summary.pdf (2p), SOC2_Type_II_redacted.pdf (attestation stub), pen_test_summary_2026Q2.pdf (redacted).

5) Audit access and logs:
- Audit logs retained in-central for hosted; Dedicated/Private options provide customer log export and s3 log retention policies. Full API audit trails available for 90 days by default; extended retention via add-on.

6) Change management / deployment controls:
- Canary rollouts, A/B gating, automated rollback on error rate regressions; each deploy goes through CI gates and staged infra checks. Change approvals are recorded in our ticketing system (links included).

7) Third-party dependencies and subcontractors:
- Public cloud providers: AWS (primary), optional GCP region. Container runtime vendors and DLL providers listed in the Controls Matrix. We maintain vendor risk assessments and shared-responsibility mappings.
